title: Concrete security features valued over trust seals
statement:
In an experimental study of e-commerce trust, consumers valued concrete security features significantly more than third-party privacy seals, privacy statements, or third-party security seals, so visible functional security evidence can be a stronger trust surface than certification marks alone. (ScienceDirect)
